$note: One indirection between 'this surface wants a picture' and 'here is the file'.
Consumed by resolveArt() in docs/app.js. A 404 on this file is not an error:
every caller falls through to the behavior it had before this file existed.
SHAPE: groups.<group_id>.<slot_name> = { mode, candidates }.
Slots are scoped by group -- a group that declares nothing (or declares an
empty candidate list) resolves to null, which is what pushes its callers onto
the existing fallback tiers. Empty is the normal state, not a broken one.
MODES:
fixed   always candidates[0].
weekly  candidates[week % candidates.length], where week is standings
meta.as_of_week. week is null before the season's first scored
week -- today, for all three groups, and again every rollover --
and a null/non-integer week resolves to candidates[0], i.e.
identical to fixed. Rotation is an addition to day-one behavior,
never a precondition for it.
random  a uniform pick, independent of week.
TOKENS: {group} always expands; per-subject slots also expand {id}.
Substitution runs AFTER selection so rotation never depends on the subject.
by_id (OPTIONAL, per-subject slots only): { <id>: { mode, candidates } }.
Because selection runs before {id} is substituted, ONE group-level list has
to fit every subject in the group -- so a three-variant list written for the
one manager who has three hands the manager who has one a _03 that is a 404.
A subject listed in by_id uses their own spec instead; anyone absent falls
through to the group's. Rotation still happens within the chosen spec only.
CANDIDATE STRINGS are docs-relative image paths, EXCEPT manager_avatar,
whose candidates are size-suffix BASES -- app.js appends _56.webp / _112.webp
to build the 1x/2x srcset pair, exactly as it did before slots existed.
manager_avatar is still gated by assets/portraits/index.json. This file
chooses WHICH avatar a manager gets, never WHETHER they have one; without
that gate a declared candidate would emit an for every manager and put
the 404s the manifest exists to prevent right back.

$why: REPOINTED from assets/portraits/{group}/{id}.webp. Three directories,
three consumers, one source image each -- they are NOT interchangeable:
assets/profiles/  full-bleed page hero, long edge 1200 (managers.html)
assets/portraits/ 256px poster + face crop for the lightbox rail
img/avatars/      56/112 square crops for the standings rows
Pointing the hero at the 256px poster would upscale it four times over.
mode is `fixed` because panel has exactly one image per manager today.
The day a manager gets a second, this becomes `random` and lists every
variant -- the slot already supports it, no page change required.
Real family photographs and period gag artifacts rather than the
AI coach-card treatment the other three groups use -- a deliberate
difference in kind, and the warmer register suits the group that
carries the straight-tone profiles.
gayden and holly each have two and rotate; the other six take the
group default. Every path was checked against disk before it was
declared.
One image per manager, so `fixed`, same as panel. manager_avatar and
hero_banner stay empty: CEC has profile art and nothing else yet, and a
declared-but-missing candidate is a 404 on the live page.
Scaffolded with the group. Every slot is declared and every candidate list
